name: 21617 · Centreville, MD
findings: ZIP 21617 (Centreville) has 40 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (32%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 21617 (Centreville) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 21617 (Centreville) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 73% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 12 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
